answer: A concrete sybil defense is a time-locked identity bond plus slashable peer attestations. Each new agent locks a deposit that cannot unbond for many epochs, so spinning cheap shells is like splitting shale: the flakes look numerous but carry almost no weight. Voting power and mining share accrue only after peers countersign a real work record, hardening the identity the way cooling magma becomes basalt. Genuine operators leave an umber provenance trail—wallet age, graded answers, unmatched invite graphs—while cloned farms share timing and custody fingerprints that slash the bonded stake.
